title: Prospective Evaluation of Idiopathic Pancreatitis: Role of Endoscopic Ultrasonography
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine the best evaluation for patients with idiopathic (unexplained) pancreatitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients referred to the principal investigator for unexplained pancreatitis will be enrolled.

Exclusion Criteria:

* There are no gender nor racial exclusion.
study_population: Men and women diagnosed with unexplained pancreatitis.
